thread_text:
Jordan Lee: Follow-up from today's all-hands runtime Q&A. I captured a few sticky points about kernel rollout sequencing, batch windows for interactive APIs, and cache retention strategies. Dropping them here so folks can weigh in.

Priya Desai: Thanks Jordan. I'll take kernel & cache notes; Maya can confirm schedule and Ravi on batching defaults.

Jordan Lee: 1) Sequence: Are we planning a progressive kernel roll that can be reverted per-region, or a single global toggle? Customers want per-region control.

Maya Torres: Progressive per-region toggle. We'll ship an opt-in release channel in the Console where admins can flip clusters independently. Global default flip only after at least 2 region canaries and a 48h stability window.

Leah Kim: For Dedicated customers on long-term reservations, will they be forced into the new kernel? Some asked about guaranteed ABI stability.

Priya Desai: No forced migration. Dedicated gets an extended opt-in window and a compatibility shim for model runtime ABI for three months. We'll keep the older kernel binary on nodes for fallback.

Jordan Lee: 2) Batch sizing: team asked whether the console recommendations should show batch_window_ms or batch_target_tokens. Thoughts?

Ravi Singh: Showing both is better. Users think in ms for latency, tokens for throughput. Default presets will be: interactive -> {"batch_window_ms":"15" , "batch_target_tokens":"64"}; high-throughput -> {"batch_window_ms":"45","batch_target_tokens":"512"}. We're testing an adaptive_v2 that shifts window based on queue depth.

Leah Kim: That adaptive_v2, will it increase tail latency unpredictably? Some product folks worried about sudden spikes.

Ravi Singh: We have a guardrail: adaptive_v2 uses a hard p99 cap per route. If p99 exceeds threshold we clamp to conservative window and emit an alert.

Jordan Lee: 3) KV cache eviction semantics: customers reported conversational context losing warm prefixes after short idle periods. Any changes planned?

Priya Desai: Going from purely LRU -> segmented LRU. Hot prefixes get promoted to a pinned segment. Default config: pinned_ratio=0.05, global_max_entries=120000, idle_ttl_ms=900000 (15m) for non-pinned entries. Pinned entries only evicted under OOM.

Leah Kim: Can tenants mark specific conversation IDs as pinned via API?

Priya Desai: Yes. We'll add an api flag `cache.pin=true` per session and a Console switch to view pinned counts.

Maya Torres: Timeline: console pin UI and per-region toggles in May rollout. Kernel progressive canaries start early June. Full global default flip expected late July pending metrics.

Jordan Lee: 4) Telemetry: What signals will be surfaced to customers so they can validate no quality regressions?

Priya Desai: We'll add a small eval suite in the Catalog -> Model -> Regression section that runs customer-provided prompts (opt-in) and shows metric diffs for BLEU/ROUGE-like similarity and token-level deltas. Also, token-cost and latency deltas per-route in the Console.

Leah Kim: Nice. Can we also add a webhook when canary fails per-tenant so SEs can be looped in?

Maya Torres: Yes, adding canary-fail webhook + slack notification channel for tenants configured in Console.

deploy-bot: Canary job started: kernel-v4.1-canary on cluster us-west-2 (job id 4629).

Ravi Singh: Quick note on default numbers: we recommend customers start with interactive profile, monitor p95, then move to high-throughput if token rates > 10k tokens/s sustained.

Jordan Lee: Action items: Maya publish per-region schedule + webhook docs this week, Priya add pinned-cache API examples to docs, Ravi publish adaptive_v2 behavior note with guardrail thresholds, Leah to draft a short customer FAQ explaining migration choices. I'll collate and add to the all-hands follow-up doc.

Maya Torres: Roger that, will post schedule and add rollback steps.

Priya Desai: I'll open a docs PR with example curl + YAML for `cache.pin` and pinned_ratio explanation.

Leah Kim: I'll start the FAQ draft and share a link here when ready.

Jordan Lee: Thanks everyone. If you want me to split into separate tickets for each action item, say so and I'll do that.

Ravi Singh: Please yes, makes tracking easier.

Jordan Lee: Added JIRA epic: RUNTIME-6412 and child tickets for each action. I'll paste links once created. :white_check_mark:
